description: Payee risk check. Screens a payee wallet address and name against the OFAC SDN sanctions list and checks the merchant domain's registration age and DNS. Returns risk low|medium|high|unknown with flags such as sanctioned_address, sanctioned_name_possible, new_domain. Call this before a USDC payment when you only have a payee name, wallet or domain. Provide at least one of domain, address, or name; inputs may be combined, and domain accepts a hostname or URL. For an x402 challenge or cart and an allow/hold/block spending-rule decision, use preflight_payment instead. Price $0.01 per call (free trial first).

domain.description: Merchant domain or URL, e.g. shop.example.com

name: check_payee

data_as_of.description: Timestamp of the sanctions data used

domain.description: Domain age/DNS signals, or null if no domain given

flags.description: e.g. sanctioned_address, sanctioned_name_exact, sanctioned_name_possible, new_domain, domain_no_dns

title: Check payee before paying
